text_blocks.snippet: In Type 2 diabetes, the body either doesn't produce enough insulin or can't properly use the insulin it produces, leading to high blood sugar levels. Insulin resistance, where cells don't respond to insulin effectively, is a key factor. While lifestyle changes like diet and exercise are crucial, insulin injections may become necessary when the body can't produce enough insulin to manage blood sugar on its own.
